options.name: Ties cut with Karlen
options.desc: The Karlenese federation has cut ties with our country. We expect no special treatment from them.

options.name: Small Karlen trade agreement
options.desc: The country has signed a trade deal with Karlen, allowing for an easier transfer of goods, capital and workforce between the countries.

options.name: Karlen partnership
options.desc: The country's partnership with Karlen has been extended to include a military alliance, a customs union and a migration pact.
